# Cloudflare Workers

Runs the app on Cloudflare Workers via @cloudflare/vite-plugin.

Id `runtime/cloudflare`: Cloudflare Workers, in the Runtime slot. Template: [`templates/runtime/cloudflare/`](../../templates/runtime/cloudflare/).

## What it is for

Every project has it. The app runs as one Cloudflare Worker, and `@cloudflare/vite-plugin` runs that Worker in workerd during `pnpm dev`. It owns two files the rest of the app is built around: `apps/web/src/server.ts`, the Worker entry, and `apps/web/src/server/cloudflare.ts`, the one file that reads the Worker environment.

## Add it

Every project has it; there is nothing to choose.

```sh
npm create efforge my-app
```

## Needs

Nothing else.

## Conflicts with

Nothing.

## Service and layer

None: this add-on adds no service of its own.

| `apps/web/vite.config.ts` | Always |
| `wrangler.jsonc` | `infra=none` |

## Files it edits

`efforge add` makes these edits with AST transforms, so it changes only what is listed and leaves the rest of each file alone.

### `apps/web/package.json`

- Adds the dependencies listed below.

### `pnpm-workspace.yaml`

- Pins the new dependencies in the `catalog`.

### `efforge.jsonc`

- Records the add-on in the stack and the hashes of the files it wrote.
